judgment_text:
Prayer : contempt petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, to punish the Contemnors/Respondents for their willful, deliberate, disobedience of the order of this Court made in C.M.P.(MD) No. 5174 of 2025 in A.S.(MD) No. 112 of 2021, dated 15-4-2025

The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.R. Swaminathan, J.:— When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned Additional Government Pleader informed the Court that he will suitably advise the contemnors to make appropriate entries in the encumbrance register based on the order dated 15-4-2025 passed by us in C.M.P.(MD) No. 5174 of 2025 in A.S.(MD) No. 112 of 2021.

2. Recording the stand of the learned Additional Government Pleader, this contempt petition is closed.
